stories.title: Prominent Hong Kong activist pleads guilty to colluding with foreign interests
stories.summary: A prominent Hong Kong democracy activist, Joshua Wong, has pleaded guilty to a charge of colluding with foreign interests under a Beijing-imposed national security law.

stories.title: How AI is being used to track art stolen by the Nazis
stories.summary: As momentum builds to recover artworks stolen during World War Two by the Nazis, researchers have created an AI chatbot that aims to trace the ownership and location history of works of art.

stories.title: Chevron's expansion in Venezuela has implications for the oil industry and the planet
stories.summary: Chevron is expanding its current operations in Venezuela. The deal expands the company's footprint at a time of political and economic uncertainty in Venezuela.

stories.title: Secretly moving Raja Shehadeh's diaries from Israeli-occupied West Bank to Scotland
stories.summary: A leading Palestinian writer has secretly moved his archives from the Israeli-occupied West Bank to Scotland, to save it from the risk of destruction in Israeli military operations.

stories.title: How do you take care of parents who may not have taken great care of you?
stories.summary: NPR's "It's Been a Minute" podcast explores the complexities of adults who wind up having to care for aging parents with whom they may have had a fraught or even abusive child relationship.

stories.title: Supreme Court arguments can drag on. Chief Justice Roberts is considering some change
stories.summary: Chief Justice John Roberts says he's thinking about how to dial back extra-long oral arguments at the Supreme Court.
